items.title: Massive XL is here: Native Instruments supersizes its flagship soft synth with AI-powered preset generation, custom wavetables and much more
items.excerpt: 20 years after Massive, Native Instruments unveils Massive XL, which uses AI to turn audio samples into synth patches, alongside custom wavetables and an expanded effects suite.

items.title: NI's new Massive XL is nicely overstuffed but easier to morph, mutate, and play
items.excerpt: A first hands-on with Massive XL: mutation and audio-to-preset generation options that lead sound designers into more tweaking rather than away from it, at a $99 intro price.

items.title: Tracktion Waveform Pro 14.1 Update Adds AI-Assisted Plugin Creation
items.excerpt: With the version 14.1 update, Tracktion Waveform Pro lets users build their own instruments and effects inside the DAW using AI-assisted code generation.

items.title: Apple Creator Studio update adds MotionVFX to Final Cut, and AI to everywhere
items.excerpt: Logic Pro gets a beta AI assistant built with OpenAI that can edit existing projects, start new songs and generate vocal tracks from text prompts; Stem Splitter can now isolate or swap drum parts.

items.title: Charlotte de Witte announces new EP, 'Azadi', featuring AI vocalist NAVA
items.excerpt: Charlotte de Witte's three-track KNTXT EP features NAVA, an AI vocalist created by British-Iranian artist Farbod Mehr to represent Iranian women banned from singing in public; the choice has drawn mixed reactions.

items.title: Edged Out Records built 'the first costume shop for AI agents'
items.excerpt: Independent label Edged Out Records launched a marketing campaign riffing on Jolly, the plush mascot Meta uses for its Muse AI agent, building a 'costume shop' for AI agents.

items.title: Here's Every Company Fighting Subpoenas in Suno's Legal Fight With Universal and Sony Music
items.excerpt: A rundown of the companies resisting subpoenas in UMG and Sony Music's AI-training lawsuit against Suno, from investors to the MLC, DistroKid and Apple.

items.title: Suno Files Subpoena Demands Against Apple As Major Label Legal War Intensifies
items.excerpt: Apple moves to quash Suno's subpoena in the UMG/Sony AI case, arguing the demand for Apple Music data is superfluous and goes well beyond what Suno needs.

items.title: Stop sending me vibecoded plugins, I'm begging you
items.excerpt: MusicTech's inbox is drowning in AI-vibecoded audio plugins; the piece explains why that's a problem and which indie developers are using AI coding tools properly.

items.title: Introducing Instant Soundtracks
items.excerpt: ElevenLabs' Instant Soundtracks scores an uploaded video with original music, detects sound-effect cues and places generated SFX on separate timeline layers in one pass; available in ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic and the API. (Off-list: no on-list outlet covered it.)

items.title: 수노 AI곡 'The Adult I Dreamed Of', 멜론 3위인데 AI 표기는 없다
items.excerpt: Suno로 만든 Meomuru(머무르)의 AI 곡이 멜론 Top 100 3위, 유튜브 1,000만 뷰에 근접했지만 AI 표기는 없다. AI 표기 필요 응답 85.6%. (Off-list Korea angle: no allowed outlet covers the Korean chart story.)
